title: TTP Ambush Kills 10 Police in Kohat
detail: Militants ambushed a police convoy returning from an anti-illegal-gold-mining operation at Darbukach, Gumbat tehsil, Kohat district, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, on November 11, 2026. KP Police put the toll at 10 officers (including DSP Haider Zaman) and 18 militants killed, with 12 injured; the TTP claimed responsibility. The militant toll is a police figure not independently confirmed, and early reports varied between 8 and 11 police dead.

media.caption: 10 cops martyred, 18 terrorists killed in Kohat
